name: Northampton
source: HM Land Registry, official INSPIRE Index Polygons WMS / Use land and property data service

queries.query: Northampton England official cadastral parcel map GIS API land parcels
queries.result: Found HM Land Registry's first-party INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset and official WMS. The service documents CP.CadastralParcel coverage for England and Wales; the National Polygon Service is a separate licensed product requiring an account/licence.

queries.query: Northampton England official cadastral parcel map GIS API land parcels (English is the UK's local administrative language)
queries.result: No distinct translated UK cadastral terminology is used for this jurisdiction; the same first-party HM Land Registry INSPIRE and National Polygon Service sources were found and checked.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: England and Wales; national cadastral/registered-property index polygons
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official guidance describes open INSPIRE polygons as indicative shapes/positions of freehold registered property, with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, updated monthly and published as GML.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Separate local-authority files for England and Wales
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official dataset page states that files are divided by local authority and that polygon extent is indicative, not a definitive title boundary.
Anonymous WMS capabilities returned CP.CadastralParcel with CRS EPSG:27700 and CRS:84 and the national geographic extent including Northampton.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official WMS capabilities returned; CP.CadastralParcel layer present, national extent includes Northampton, and CRS:84/EPSG:27700 are advertised.
Response explicitly said Service WFS is disabled; no feature geometry or native ID was retained.
Official WMS replied LayerNotQueryable; no bounded ID/geometry response was available. The request envelope surrounded the exact preserved WUP point and was not used to infer absence.
National Polygon Service documentation confirms full freehold/leasehold polygon data exists but is chargeable/licensed and requires account access; no account or credentials were used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry national service covering England and Wales; Northampton lies within the advertised extent.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official metadata and WMS capabilities verified anonymously; no parcel feature response verified for the Northampton point or local envelope.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: First-party national cadastral/registered-property custodian and public INSPIRE service evidenced.

qualityAssessment.crs: Official WMS advertises CRS:84 and EPSG:27700; no geometry was retained or transformed.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: INSPIRE ID is documented by HM Land Registry as the unique polygon identity, but no feature-level ID was returned in the bounded anonymous requests.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or document fields were requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify the adapter, national-vs-city coverage semantics, indicative-boundary limitations, access/licensing, and safe field behavior before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [52.2468769329282,-0.884093403196014] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
WMS national extent and an exact-point/non-queryable response do not establish citywide parcel availability or absence.
The open INSPIRE product covers indicative freehold registered-property polygons; the full National Polygon Service is a separate licensed product.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON sample was retained because the public WMS did not provide a queryable feature response and WFS was disabled. If later obtained through an authorized public download, retain only the stable native INSPIRE ID as properties.id and record native field mapping here.
